name: Paper Fold
description: In a sunlit paper workshop the subject folds into an origami crane and flutters away.

wardrobe.man: a crisp white cotton shirt and white trousers
wardrobe.woman: a crisp white cotton shirt and white trousers
wardrobe.person: a crisp white cotton shirt and white trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands in a bright minimalist paper workshop, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}. Long sheets of white paper hang from lines above, folded paper cranes rest on a wooden table on the left, and soft morning sun pours through a large window on the right, making the paper glow. Medium-wide shot at eye level, the {subject} centered, full body visible. Cinematic photography, soft warm sunlight from the right, airy white tones, gentle shadows. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, blank white paper sheets throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands still in the paper workshop, eyes on a point just past the camera. The whole figure turns into crisp white paper with visible fibres, then folds along sharp creases, the arms and the legs tucking in and the body flattening and folding again and again in quick precise folds, until it becomes a large white origami crane that rests on the floor for a moment, flaps its paper wings once and flutters up and out of the window to the right. The camera holds a steady medium-wide shot and tilts up slightly with the crane. Sound: crisp paper crinkling, sharp folding snaps, a soft flutter of paper wings. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, paper with real fibres, creases and light weight, sharp detail, stable picture.
